anonymization.accounts: Display labels use work-account/personal-account; identifier keys use work_account/personal_account.
anonymization.paths: Evidence paths are relative to the repository root; .. retains locations outside it. Historical commands anchor external paths at ${PWD}. Evidence was not copied or moved.
anonymization.history: Original timestamps, hashes, results and caveats are retained. Labels and paths are anonymized representations; historical verification does not attest to edited bytes or current live state.

source.hash_method: sorted rg --files crates tools/local-model-router Cargo.toml Cargo.lock; aggregate relative-path + NUL + file SHA-256 + newline

behavior: Required refreshed account/read is separate from optional quota presentation and uses the full bounded deadline.
Workspace-plus-normalized-user fingerprints retain the existing format; API keys and incomplete or conflicting workspace identities fail closed.
New, resumed and handoff conversations share asynchronous verification of their exact selected CODEX_HOME.
Missing/changed identity requires explicit inspection or native login; no label-based identity inference or silent rebinding.
Native Codex login is offered for inherited and isolated homes without logout; successful exit is followed by fresh verification.
Failed/cancelled login cannot authorize inference; prior approvals are invalidated when login begins.
Pending command, session label, initial handoff input and synchronization arriving during authentication are preserved.
Late results cannot redirect another account's actions, close its name editor, or steal user-changed focus.
A conversation waiting for auth cannot adopt an unrelated rollout.

red_before_green: Delayed account/read versus old 250 ms quota enrichment
Quota error versus independent valid account
Long identity details clipping the recovery choice
Late result redirecting another account panel
Inspection during login releasing work after cancellation
Successful background recovery dismissing another account editor
validation.live_required_identity_probe: passed; no inference or browser login
validation.review: no known CRITICAL/HIGH issues in bounded lifecycle review after red/green regressions

installation.status: atomically replaced after source-tree workspace tests passed

simplifications: Removed synchronous rejection-only launch checking and its discarded continuation.
Reused one process runner for quota and required identity RPCs.
Centralized authentication lifecycle instead of per-launch-path login variants.
remaining_gaps: Real interactive OAuth login/account selection was not performed. Exact-home login completion uses owned fake-provider PTY fixtures; cancellation/failure authorization is covered by state-machine regression tests.
The current saved work-account binding is stale. The user must explicitly confirm the displayed identity or sign into the intended account; credentials and bindings were not silently repaired.
API-key identities cannot provide the ChatGPT workspace/user binding required by this guard.
Rolling experimental Codex response shapes can change; current workspaceRouting was also observed directly on local Codex 0.163.0.
